Sam: Quick sync  rehearsal tomorrow 11:00 PT for 'Practical Inference Economics'. Need final run-of-show, pre-show checklist, and failover owners. Please respond ASAP.

Priya: Ack. Draft run-of-show below. I suggest Q&A 20m instead of 15.

Jon: I can take Demo A (routing + cache). Priya will do Demo B (quantized perf). I'll be on-stage ops for handoff.

OpsBot: Rehearsal scheduled: 2026-04-20 11:00 PT. Zoom: https://zoom.example/rehearsal. Pre-show webhook at 10:45.

Sam: Draft run-of-show:
```
11:00 - Doors / pre-roll
11:05 - Host welcome + agenda (Sam) - 5m
11:10 - Keynote: cost-first patterns (Priya) - 10m
11:20 - Demo A: routing + cache (Jon) - 12m (warm cache 10m prior)
11:32 - Demo B: quant & cost numbers (Priya) - 8m
11:40 - Panel: tradeoffs & ops checklist (Sam, Jon, Priya) - 15m
11:55 - Live Q&A (All) - 20m
12:15 - Close + CTA (Sam) - 5m
```

InfraOps: Pre-show checklist (to be automated): warm-cache (short + long prompt), /v1/health on primary and fallback, confirm captions, confirm recording. Endpoints: primary /v1/generate/prod, fallback /v1/generate/quant-v2, region fallback host us-east.infer.redwood.

Jon: For rehearse, please simulate two failures: 1) OOM -> switch to quant-v2, 2) US-WEST region outage -> reroute to us-east. Priya will call the fallback live.

Priya: I'll prepare a 1-slide benchmark (95th latency + $/1k tokens) and drop in deck by EOD. Also adding a 'text-only' fallback slide.

Sam: Final asks: deck v3 in drive by EOD, bios/headshots in folder, rehearsal recorded and notes uploaded within 24h. I'll lock run-of-show at 5pm today.

InfraOps: Adding a simple curl snippet to the drive for the rehearsal.

Sam: Thanks team. Locking at 5pm if no objections.

Jon: No objections.

Priya: All good.

OpsBot: Rehearsal reminder will ping 30m prior.
